balls.text: 147 all out! Three deliveries and three wickets. Another short pitched ball outside off stump, he comes down the track to go big but gets a top edge to short third where Siraj takes the catch with a bit of fumble

Terrible mix-up! Unfortunate for Mohit. Full length ball outside off, he goes for a push and misses. Vijay Shankar had already left to take the strike. Karthik throws the ball immediately to Vyshak, who takes the bails off a the non-striker's end
Taken! Short ball outside off, pace off, clears the front leg but doesn't have enough power to clear the fielder at deep point
Well bowled. Yorker to end the spell, hits it back to bowler
Short ball at 140kmph, pulled away over keeper's head for four. Didn't middle it
Back of a length delivery outside off, looks to slice it towards point, misses
Pace off. Low full toss around off, hits it gently to off side to get off the mark
Length ball nips back in, pushed to extra cover for one
Shot! That's what he can do. Full length ball on middle, hits this straight down the ground for four
Starts with a full toss going down the leg

Brilliant catch from Vyshak! Short delivery outside off stump, he looks to pull this across the line but gets a top edge to deep third. Vyshak runs in to his right and dives at the perfect time to complete the catch, wicket no.2 for Dayal
Short ball outside off, pace off, looked like Tewatia was expecting this. Waits for it and pulls this away on the backfoot to leg side for four
Length ball on the hips, taps it away to deep midwicket

Cleaned up! Excellent from Dayal. He mixed up the pace very well. Bowls a yorker on leg stump, Rashid shuffles across and tries to play this towards leg side, exposing his middle and leg stumps. He misses and Dayal knocks off the leg stump
Pace off. Short ball outside off, Rashid has a smile after failing to connect
Nearly a catch! Very good effort from Yash. Length ball outside off, looks to go over long-off, top edges to deep third from where Yash runs in and tries to get hold of the ball but couldn't
Bangs in a bouncer, goes for a pull and misses
Yorker on middle and leg stump, jams it through fine leg for four. Doesn't middle it but he doesn't mind
Short of a length delivery outside off, shuffles across to hit but can't reach
Shot! Full length delivery outside off, clears front leg and struck powerfully through covers for four
Length ball slightly outside off, 139.7kmph, Rashid swings his bat and misses
Full  length and outside off stump, pushed to covers
Full and around off, taps away to leg side to keep the strike
Hot back to the bowler
Third four of the over! Fuller on the stumps, swept away to deep backward point. Lomror couldn't stop the ball
Four more! 14 off the first three. Short and wide of off, he heaves this over covers
Fuller around off stump, he will still get down on one knee and plays a slog sweep to deep midwicket fence for a neat six!
Full and down the leg, swept away to deep square for four. Loses balance
Short of a length ball on the stumps, guided to deep backward point
Overpitched at 143kmph, outside off, pushed to covers
Yorker outside off, pace off, drilled to leg side. Good comeback from Vyshak
Another short delivery outside off, he just threw his bat at it to send this over deep square fence
Short of good length on stumps, pulled away to deep square
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, gets an inside edge on to the keeper
Bangs in a bouncer, Rashid looks to pull again and misses. This short-ball approach from RCB is working fine
Back of a length delivery around middle and off, steered to deep backward point
Short ball again on the hips, pulled away to deep square leg. Lands safely in front of the fielder
Full ball outside off, looked a bit like Dhoni;s helicopter shot, gets an edge towards long-off
139.7kmph, short ball on the body, looks to pull it away without looking at the ball, gets hit on the right shoulder. Ouch!
Short of a length ball on the hips, steers this to deep backward point
Short of a length delivery outside off, beaten by bounce, swing and a miss
Taps this to leg side for one

RCB are celebrating the run-out! Pace off, full length on middle and off, he taps this towards point. Shahrukh wants the run but is sent back. Kohli nails a direct hit at the non-striker's end. And he is gone! Brilliant from Kohli
A 140kmph yoker on middle and leg, drilled to deep midwicket
Short of a length delivery, guides to deep third for a single
Full and wide of off stump, he gets the toe end of the bat towards deep third for one
Short of a length on stumps, goes down on one knee and pulls this away to deep square to get off the mark
Fuller on stumps, 94.6kmph, taps to leg side

Karn strikes back! Miller's gone. The legspinner wins the battle. Bowls full on middle and leg, Miller slices it across the line, doesn't connect well this time. Maxwell at long-on collects the ball cleanly. Miller is clearly disappointed
Another six off Karn, but this time towards off side! Karn goes full and wide of off, he whacks it over cover for six
Full on leg, taps to midwicket for a quick run
Length ball around off, goes back to cut and doesn't connect well
Full and down the leg, gets a bit of glove on it. off to keeper
This time he connects it well! 50 stand for the duo. Short delivery outside off again, pulled away powerfully towards mid-on for a 94-m six
Short delivery outside off, pace on, swing and a miss
Dropped! by Karn! Short of a length delivery, goes for a pull towards deep fine leg. It's low and flat. Karn drops a sitter
Back of a length delivery on stumps, defended
143.2kmph. Length ball around off, uses the angle well to cut away to deep point
12  runs from the over! Lovely shot from SRK. Tossed up outside off, hits this over deep extra cover for four
Hit back to the bowler
Full on leg stump, goes back to pull but doesn't middle it
Fuller on leg, taps it to deep square for a single
Shot! Fuller on leg stump, he picks it up nicely and lofts this over deep midwicket fence for a 90-m six. Hugeeeeeee!
Pitched slightly short on the stumps, pulled away on the backfoot to deep midwicket
Full length ball on stumps, hit back to bowler
Length delivery on middle and off, goes back and punches this to off side for one
Full length ball on leg stump, nudges to deep backward square leg for one
Much-needed four! Back of a length delivery, tries to pull this away, there is a little bit of extra bounce, top edges to deep third

Is that run-out? Full length delivery on middle and off, he taps it gently to mid-on and takes a quick single. Faf du Plessis picks it up and fires in a throw at non-striker's end. But looks like Miller is safe
Short of a length ball around off, just guides this to deep third, Yash Dayal with an excellent save near the rope!
Bangs in a bouncer, it hits the helmet of Shahrukh as he goes for a pull and misses. Ball flies off towards fine leg. Physio runs in to check. He looks okay
Falls short of Maxwell! Back of a length delivery, Miller hits this across the line towards deep midwicket but doesn't middle it well
Slightly overpitched on the stumps, driven neatly to the left of mid-off for a convincing four from Miller
Similar delivery. Bowls full length on middle stump, digs it out to mid-off
Fuller on middle stump, punched towards mid-off. Siraj fumbles but Miller doesn't take a run
Bowl full and wide of off stump, shaping away, Shahrukh hits this towards point for four
Length delivery on stumps, moving away, pushed to deep backward point for one
Short delivery on hips going down the leg. DK thinks there is a bit of glove in it. RCB take the review for caught behind. UltraEdge confirms there is no bat/glove involved. RCB lose their review
Pitches full and wide of off stump, moves away a bit, SRK swings his bat again and misses
Back of a length delivery, stays low, a swing and a miss
Full length delivery on middle stump, defended with soft hands
Length delivery on stumps, moving away, flicked towards deep square for boundary
gets off the mark with a boundary! Full length ball outside off, cut away nicely towards point for four
Full length delivery around off stump, pushed gently to off side
Bowls full length on the stumps, defended with soft hands

GT in big trouble! Another batter, the in-form batter, walks away inside the powerplay. Short of a length delivery on off, Sudharsan looks to power it through leg side but there is no timing on it. Ends up top-edging to Kohli at mid-off. Big, big wicket for RCB
Full length delivery on the middle, driven straight to covers
He also starts with a back of a length delivery outside off, worked to point-cover for a single
Length delivery around off and middle, punches on the backfoot. Gets an under-edge as it goes off to first slip
Back of a length delivery outside off, has a swing at it and misses
Length ball around middle and off, flicked away to on side for one
Short of a length ball, looks to lofts this over mid-off, doesn't time it well. Top edges but the ball falls in front of Faf
Not quite from the middle of the bat but will get two. Full ball around off stump, hots down the ground
Full length ball around off and middle, driven to mid-on for a quick single
Very lucky to not get an inside edge. Short of a length around middle stump, nips back in sharply and the ball runs off to fine leg

Wicket no.2  for Siraj! What a start this has been from Siraj. Bowls a length ball around off stump, seams away, Gill looks to play a lofted shot but manages only the toe end of the bat. Vyshak takes the catch comfortably at deep point to leave GT 10 for 2
Full length delivery around off stump, pushed straight to mid-on fielder
Bowls full around middle and off stump, worked to deep third for a single
Another short delivery from Siraj, pace on, Sudharsan goes down to play an upper cut but misses
Short of a length delivery on the hips, guided to leg side for one
Starts with a wide, back of a length ball going down the leg. Karthik does well to save the boundary
Full length ball pitched outside off stump, cut away to deep point for one
Short of a length delivery, Gill comes down the track and tries to hit this across the line, misses
Pace off now. Full length ball outside off, waits for the delivery and then pushes it to long-on. 104kmph
Full length delivery outside off, almost yorker-length, drilled to backward point
Hold that pose! Full length delivery around off stump, lofts it straight over the bowler's head but will only get a couple of runs
Niceeee! Pitches it full and wide of off, Sudharshan comes down the ground to whack it and misses
Excellent start from Siraj! Full length ball on middle and off, holds a bit into the surface, Sudharshan just hit it straight down the ground to get off the mark
Full length delivery going down the leg, flicks and misses. Wide signalled
Length ball on the middle stumps, defended with soft hands to the off side
Full length delivery on middle and off stump, driven along the ground to mid-off

Saha gone! Siraj gets the early breakthrough for RCB. No foot movement from Saha here. A short of a length delivery pitched outside off, an outswinger, Saha pokes at it and Karthik completes an easy catch
Full length delivery on middle stump, defended back to the bowler
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump, Saha can't middle it
Yorker length on leg stump, drilled to short midwicket. Just one off the first over!
Bowls full around off stump, leans forward and pushes to covers
Bowls fullish down the legside, plays an inside out shot to long-off  along the ground to get off the mark
Fuller on the stumps again, defended
Full length delivery outside off, punched on the backfoot to ocvers
Full ball on the stumps, pushed to off side
full toss, slugged downtown! RCB have got the job done and keep their playoff hopes alive
flat outside off, punched to backward point
floated up on the stumps, swept in orthodox fashion to deep backward square leg

reverse-swept from off stump, Saha is bellowing an appeal for lbw... Looked like bat to me but Gill decides to have a punt on the DRS. Yep, straight off the bat sticker/gloves, so that one is torched!
Sweep-nil Singh! Plants the front foot and cracks another cross-batted shot away to the fence, bringing the W within touching distance
round the wicket, Swapnil sweeps, crashed through backward square! Excellent connection from the No. 8 and he brings the crowd to their feet
pushes it across the bows again, DK cushions one into the point region
fizzed down on off stump, 94kph and blocked on the front foot
pushed through, 93kph and tickled off the pads... Saha hares across as they take a leg bye, hits at the non-striker's end but Swapnil was home
flattish googly going across outside off. Swapnil chops down on it
googly, 91kph outside off, clipped down to long-on
fired down on off, poked into the off side for one
flat outside off and carved to the rope! Too much width this time, 98kph and Karthik cashes in again. RCB beginning to breathe easy again
drops short and thrashed for four more! Karthik is like quicksilver on his feet as he swings the ball through backward square leg. Rashid looks bewildered
brings out the reverse-sweep, gets a couple out to deep backward point
fizzed down and crashed through midwicket! Too full and DK steps out, times it beautifully for four
flat outside off and cut straight to backward point
92kph outside off, spins sharply! Swapnil is across his stumps and beaten on the inside edge

gottim, Kohli nicks off! Gets the wrong'un in the right area this time, full and inviting the drive and RCB's bellwether batter only succeeds in feathering a catch behind. Silence around the Chinnaswamy as it dawns on the crowd their team could actually lose this...!
drops short and hammered! The googly sits up nicely and Kholi wheels it away to deep midwicket
steps on to the front foot and pushes through cover
round the wicket, tossed up and there's a stifled lbw appeal as DK looks to sweep
banged in short again, Karthik top-edges a pull... but short of Miller at deep square! Almost five for Little!

slashed straight to deep third! The dominoes RCB batters continue to fall... Green opens his shoulders up and throws the bat hopefully but only succeeds in presenting a simple catch to the man back. Fourth wicket of the night for Little. They can't muck this up, can they??
back of a length, dabbed down into the backward point region. Half-stopped and they get one
dug into the pitch again, swirling away outside off as Kohli swipes and misses
shortish in the channel, 131kph and steered out to deep point for his first run
back of a length outside off, 136kph and Kohli dabs it calmly down into the point region
tossed up and worked into the leg side, just a single off the over
beats the outside edge, flat wrong'un in the channel and Kohli swishes at it unsuccessfully
quicker and patted back to the bowler
floated up, 88kph and Kohli is forward, wants a quick single into the covers. Sent back by his partner
skidding on and punched into the covers going back
pushed through on the stumps, tapped bacl

short again, hauled to the man in the deep AGAIN! RCB are falling over themselves in their haste to get this done. Dug in by Little, Maxwell was back in the crease and heaving impetuously across the line. Miller the beneficiary once more, Little has a three-for on his first appearance of the season
goes short now and Maxwell is beaten attempting to swipe a pull
full, straight and whipped for four! Goes for the 140kph yorker but Maxwell simply pings it off the toes through midwicket

smoked... but straight to deep square leg, another one goes! Patidar takes on the shot and hits it pretty well. But the man in the deep barely has to move as the ball homes in on him a few yards in from the rope
slammed in short, but too high for the umpires
back of a length outside off, carved away violently but straight to the cover sweeper
shortish outside off, slashed down to deep third off the outside edge
looped up on the stumps and worked through midwicket, brings up the RCB 100

miscued again, this one finds a fielder! Jacks holes out, didn't pick the googly and sent a flaccid flap down the throat of long-on. Follows up his hundred with 1 off three balls. Barely a noise in the ground and Titans don't bother celebrating much either
flighted and punched down the ground coming forwards
stops in the pitch, chipped... but loops in front of extra cover! Gill was interested but the ball wouldn't come down for him
flat and angling across, 89kph and chopped down to long-off
cut away, rasping to the fence, bowled from over the wicket but too much width and Kohli slams it through the covers
length outside off, stabbed into the covers. A dot ball to finish the powerplay!

dug in, spliced to short fine leg! Little hits back, but has the damage already been done? Du Plessis was in no mood to duck a challenge but seemed hurried by the bouncer and ended up presenting a simple catch to the man on the edge of the ring
blitzed through cover along the ground, 143kph on the ball and du Plessis slams it to the rope with interest
slaughtered into the stands! A massive hit over cover... Faf opens up his stance and mooses the ball for six more!
goes to his death bowling, wide blockhole. Du Plessis was looking to shuffle away on leg stump and swipes ineffectively
back of a length and crunched! Sits up nicely as Faf leans away and collars a hard, flat pull through midwicket
full outside off, driven down to long-off. Du Plessis raises an 18-ball fifty, RCB's captain lighting a patch to this target on a balmy night at the Chinnaswamy
fired in, whipped away into the leg side
flat and hammered! Kohli is in spin-hitting mode once again! Rocks back and mauls Suthar into the crowd
tally ho! Kohli donks another one over the ropes! Length ball sliding into the hitting arc and Kohli launches it over long-on
tucked back towards the bowler
stays round the wicket, dotted on the stumps
smashed again! Pace on this time, 138kph outside off stump. Du Plessis' hands come through so fast as he cuts for four
full and munched! Back-of-the-hand slowie from Mohit. Du Plessis clears the front leg and thumps this straight, bounces just in front of the rope at long-on
fourth stump and flayed... Floaty knuckleball from Mohit and du Plessis opens up those broad shoulders to slam it through cover
length on the stumps, jabbed through mid-on
short with pace off wide of off stump, miscued into the covers for one
larruped off a length! Faf draws himself up and biffs Mohit through midwicket like a club medium-pacer
slows his pace, 87kph outside off and Kohli picks out cover
fired in straight and worked out to deep midwicket
carved away through point! Makes room again and smacks a cut to the fence
cleaned out over long-on! Tries to follow the batter as du Plessis steps out side leg stump and dumps a ful, fast delivery into the crowd, 85m hit
flattish on off, 89kph and tapped back
round the wicket, tossed up and dinked into the off side
dug in and walloped again! Another boundary for Faf, who stands tall in the crease and hauls the ball through backward square leg
shortish on the stumps, bottom-handed to midwicket
full and wide, 139kph and launched again... du Plessis goes aerial over cover but it plugs in the outfield
splat! Straight back down the ground! Full and inviting as Faf leans forward into a crashing drive that sails all the way
chipped, clears Gill's fingertips! Doesn't quite get hold of this as he goes over mid-off, but GT's captain can't quite grasp the chance
short and cuffed around the corner, du Plessis moves across and muscles the ball away to fine leg
Kohli on the charge! Belts this over midwicket, takes possession of the orange cap. No mucking about tonight from the RCB talisman
length ball, wide line and du Plessis frees up the arms to crunch this in front of point for one
fullish, 137kph and shaping away on off stump. Faf pokes it back down the track
on a length, jabbed back down past the bowler for one
nailed! Lofted over long-off! Pitched up and he steps into an imperious drive, front elbow pointing to the sky. First scoring shot of the innings, and Kohli holds the pose in regal fashion

pitched up, hint of away swing at 137kph... prodded into the covers and Kohli nearly runs himself out! Miller snaffles it on the dive and then has a wide shy. Kohli had dropped the bat while turning and would have been struggling!
